name: stratigraph
stderr:
Usage: stratigraph [options] [command]

Read a codebase and its git history; produce a grounded map of its structure.

Options:
  -v, --version              output the version number
  --repo <path>              repository to analyse (default: current directory)
  --db <path>                fact store location (default:
                             .stratigraph/<repo-name>.db)
  --config <path>            config file (default: ./stratigraph.config.json)
  --model <id>               model used by the interpretation layer
  --java-home <path>         JDK used to run the Java extractor
  --extractor-jar <path>     Java extractor jar (default: discovered)
  --no-llm                   skip the interpretation layer; structural output
                             only
  --send-source              send raw source bodies to the model API (off by
                             default)
  --format <format>          output as 'text' for a person or 'json' for a
                             pipeline (choices: "text", "json", default:
                             "text")
  -q, --quiet                suppress progress output on stderr
  -h, --help                 display help for command

Commands:
  init [options]             create or migrate the fact store, and optionally a
                             config file
  config                     show where settings come from, or set the model
                             API key
  ingest [options]           read NDJSON facts from an extractor and write them
                             to the fact store
  extract [options]          run every applicable extractor over the repository
                             and store the facts
  scan [options] [repo]      extract, mine history, analyse and report in one
                             go, then say what was and was not seen
  bench [options]            score the pipeline against the pinned corpus and
                             its hand-labelled ground truth
  history [options]          mine the repository's git history: commits, churn,
                             complexity, authorship
  analyze [options]          derive structure from stored facts: package
                             cycles, coupling, hotspots, ownership
  report [options]           write C4 diagrams, a ranked findings list and a
                             static HTML report
  diff [options]             compare two runs: findings gained and resolved,
                             and how the structure moved
  fetch-extractor [options]  download the Java extractor jar, verified against
                             a pinned checksum
  prune [options]            delete all but the newest runs from the fact
                             store, and reclaim the space
  upgrade                    upgrade Spring Boot: OpenRewrite, known fixes, an
                             opt-in AI loop, and a report of what needs you
  mcp [options]              serve the fact store over MCP on stdio, for an
                             agent to query
  doctor                     report what this machine can run
  help [command]             display help for command
